counting: total = commits + prs opened + prs merged + ai line edits. Commit dates are author dates in America/Chicago. Merge commits are skipped. A pull request counts on the day it was opened and, if merged, again on the day it merged. GitHub's contribution calendar counts a pull request once and omits some commits; this file keeps the breakdown. AI line edits come only from cursor-lines.json.
